svg.title: KFM by the numbers
svg.desc: Six figures counted from the repository at the README's evidence commit: 23 Explorer features in the Site registry; 104 connector lanes in connectors/; 314,844 water-well records and 6,598 core locations in Underground 3D; 105 Kansas counties from the 2020 Census baseline; and 1800, the first year on the map clock. Digits roll into place once.
